hero.title: Welcome to {{app_name}}
hero.subtitle: A gentle space just for you
paragraphs: **This is your private space to arrive as you are.**
No need to perform or explain yourself here. Take your time and simply be present.
Everything here stays with you: no tracking, no judgment, no agenda.

header.title: Reflection Space
header.subtitle: Continue your reflection and explore your thoughts

hero.title: Reflection Space
hero.subtitle: A private space where you can explore your emotions and thoughts.
paragraphs: Take a moment to settle in and notice what you are feeling.
This space is yours. Share freely and reflect at your own pace.
*Remember that {{app_name}} mirrors your emotions back to help you gain clarity.*

open-chat.initial-message: Hi there. I'm here to listen. What's been on your mind lately? Take your time. Just start wherever feels right.

input.label: Type a message and press Enter to send

dialog.title: Reset This Session?
messages: This will clear all messages in the current chat and start fresh.
You won't be able to recover them after reset.

dialog.title: End This Session?
messages: Ending the session will mark it as complete.
You can continue later or start a new session anytime.

dialog.title: Export This Session?
messages: You can download the session as a JSON file.
Keep it safe, it contains your private reflections.

openness.title: Openness
openness.description: How receptive you felt to new insights or perspectives.

insightMoments.title: Insight Moments
insightMoments.description: When emotional understanding connected to self-awareness.

footer.note: These curves represent the flow of your conversation, showing how awareness and calm developed over time without measuring or scoring.

mental_focus.increase: as your **mental focus** *deepened*, showing active reflection
mental_focus.decrease: as your **mental focus** *eased*, allowing more clarity

openness.decrease: while your **openness** *faded slightly*, perhaps from emotional fatigue

integration.increase: ending with moments of **insight** and *personal understanding*.
integration.decrease: with fewer **integration moments** as the session came to a close.
integration.steady: closing on a note of *balance and steadiness*.
